indices.name: S&P 500
indices.note: Gained about 115 points in the shortened holiday session, capping its best week in over a year.

indices.name: Nasdaq
indices.note: Jumped about 544 points as chip and AI stocks bounced back.

indices.name: Dow
indices.note: Rose about 592 points to another close above 50,000.

notes: Beaten-down tech and semiconductor stocks rebounded as worries about AI profitability eased; the chip index rose almost 4.7% and Micron gained about 7.6%.
Trading was light in the half-day Black Friday session, which closed at 1 p.m. ET; consumer discretionary led, helped by Amazon's roughly 4% gain on early holiday shopping data.
Vertex fell about 5% after the FDA pushed a decision on its kidney disease drug into 2027, while oil rose on fresh attacks on shipping in the Strait of Hormuz.
events: Mon 30 Nov: US markets return to a full session, opening at 17:30 Kuwait time.
Next week: the November jobs report, with traders favouring a Fed rate hike at the 8–9 Dec meeting.
